v0_new_chat_trigger.description: Runs for each new chat in v0. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

v0_new_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new message in v0. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

parameters.description: chatId.
parameters.name: chat_id

v0_new_or_updated_chat_trigger.description: Runs for each chat added or changed in v0. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

v0_new_or_updated_message_trigger.description: Runs for each message added or changed in v0. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

parameters.description: chatId.
parameters.name: chat_id

v0_new_or_updated_project_trigger.description: Runs for each project added or changed in v0. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

v0_new_project_trigger.description: Runs for each new project in v0. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
